text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, I'm so excited! I can't wait for the
Japan
Cup to start!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The lineup is too impressive! There's the
Beast,
Oguri Cap, then there's White
Lightning, Tamamo
Cross!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're forgetting someone
important!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The prettiest Umamusume of this
generation,
Gold City! She'll definitely
win today!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: They're going crazy out there.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Just listening to it is making me restless.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Is it just me, or do you always act like I'm
some
nervous wreck? I'm fine.
choice_data_list_en: Don't rush, just be yourself, alright?
Don't rush, just be yourself, okay?

text_block_list.text: Go and run like yourself.
Go and run like yourself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I guess this isn't the first time
you've told
me to be myself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You've always told me to run my own
way.
Always...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You know... why did you let me keep racing?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I was complaining literally every second,
not to
mention how unfair my manager
was to you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You even completely disregarded what I
wanted
at one point. That must've been
hard for you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But you still let me run... Why?

I promise I'll keep you on the track no
matter
what.

I promise I'll keep you on the track no
matter
what.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Is that it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Not for me? Or yourself? Or even the
fans?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: 君が走りたがってるって、わかってたから
貴方が走りたがってるって、わかってたから
choice_data_list_en: Because I knew you really wanted to run.
Because I knew you were dying to run.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haha... Seriously, you're something else.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But you know, I'm glad I chose an
overbearing
pain in the ass for my
trainer... I really am.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, wipe that stupid grin off your face.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You can show me it after the race, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Time to get out there and be me!
